blocks: Welcome to our British International School in Doha

As Qatar’s leading not-for-profit British school for pupils aged 3-18, we reinvest in exceptional teaching, facilities, and opportunities so that each child can flourish—academically, socially, and personally. The result is outstanding futures, shaped by challenge, care and a genuine culture of kindness. With 45 years of history at Doha College, every decision starts with our pupils.

Learning doesn’t end when the lesson does — it expands, deepens, and comes to life through a rich programme of activities that nurture the whole child. Our co-curricular culture is one of the defining features of the DC experience, offering pupils in both Primary and Secondary the opportunity to discover new passions, build confidence, and develop the personal qualities that shape future-ready global citizens.

Doha College is a kind, inclusive community where every pupil is known, valued, and supported. Our diverse families, dedicated staff, and shared opportunities create a strong sense of belonging and the DC Difference.
Doha College has a long-standing reputation for preparing pupils to thrive at leading universities and in competitive careers around the world.
Our global footprint reflects the strength of a British international education in Qatar, combined with the character-building foundations of the DC Learner Profile.

Through the Doha College Alumni Network (DCAN), our former pupils stay connected to a worldwide community spanning the UK, Europe, North America, Asia, and the Middle East. Each year, our graduates secure places at top global universities and progress into fields such as medicine, engineering, law, finance, technology, creative industries, and entrepreneurship.

Qatar is a welcoming, modern, and culturally rich country that offers an exceptional quality of life for individuals and families alike. With world-class facilities, safe communities, and a vibrant blend of tradition and innovation, moving to Qatar is an exciting step filled with opportunity. Whether you’re joining us as a parent or an employee, Doha College is here to support you every step of the way.
Discover where your Doha College journey begins.
Join us for our EYFS and Primary Open Day and experience how we inspire young minds through purposeful play, exploration and a nurturing learning environment.
Meet our team, explore our campus and discover what makes the early years at Doha College so special.

pages.title: Vision Mission Values - Doha College
blocks: At Doha College, we believe education should do more than prepare pupils for examinations. It should inspire curiosity, build confidence, shape character and open minds to what is possible.
Our Vision, Mission and Values provide a clear sense of who we are, what we stand for and the experience we want every pupil to have throughout their journey at Doha College.

They reflect our heritage as a leading British international school while looking confidently to the future, ensuring every pupil is challenged, supported and inspired to become the very best version of themselves.
Our vision is simple and ambitious: to inspire minds
We want every pupil to develop a lifelong curiosity for the world around them, the confidence to explore new ideas and the character to make a positive contribution.

Inspiring Minds is reflected in the way we teach, learn and grow together. It shapes the opportunities we create, the relationships we build and the expectations we have for ourselves and one another.
For our pupils, this means an education that encourages them not simply to know more, but to think deeply, question confidently and recognise the possibilities ahead of them.
Our values sit at the heart of life at Doha College.

They can be seen in the everyday experiences of Doha College pupils: in a question asked during a lesson, the determination shown on a sports field, the creativity behind a performance, the confidence to try something new or the kindness shown to another member of our community.
Discovery, Courage and Humanity provide the foundations for Inspiring Minds.
We are curious. We explore. We continue to learn.
Discovery is about encouraging pupils to ask questions, explore ideas and remain open to new possibilities.
We want our pupils to develop a genuine love of learning — to look beyond the obvious, investigate the world around them and have the confidence to follow their curiosity.
Discovery happens in classrooms, laboratories, studios, performance spaces, sports facilities and throughout the many experiences that take learning beyond the curriculum.
It is through discovery that pupils begin to understand not only what they can achieve, but what they may become.
We challenge ourselves. We take responsibility. We keep moving forward.
Courage gives pupils the confidence to step beyond what feels familiar.
It means having the ambition to aim high, the resilience to respond positively when things are difficult and the confidence to share ideas, ask questions and take opportunities.

At Doha College, we recognise that meaningful growth often comes through challenge. We therefore encourage pupils to take considered risks, learn from experience and develop the self-belief to approach the future with confidence.
Courage is not about never finding something difficult. It is about developing the strength and determination to keep learning and growing.
We are kind. We respect others. We make a positive difference.
Humanity reflects the importance we place on relationships, community and the way we treat one another.
We want every pupil to understand that success is not measured by achievement alone, but also by the contribution we make to the lives of others.
Through kindness, empathy, respect and responsibility, our pupils learn to value different perspectives and understand their place within an increasingly connected world.
Humanity ensures that as we inspire minds, we also nurture thoughtful, compassionate people who are ready to contribute positively to their communities and wider society.
